evals.name: routing-picks-the-right-lenses
evals.prompt: Ось діф локальних змін (evals/fixtures/mixed-routing.diff): торкнуто client/src/app/agents/page.tsx, server/src/db/schema.ts і нову міграцію server/drizzle/0012_agent_run_count.sql. Проведи pr-self-review для цього діфу. Нічого не змінюй у репозиторії — напиши план прогону: які групи непорожні, які лінзи піднімаються для кожної, які детерміновані гейти застосовні, і чому решта лінз не запускається.
evals.expected_output: Two non-empty groups: frontend (client/src/app/agents/page.tsx -> frontend-ui-architecture, next-best-practices, react-best-practices) and backend (schema.ts + migration -> postgresql-table-design, drizzle-orm-patterns). react-testing-library, fastify-best-practices and the perf prompt are NOT raised, because no test file, no routes.ts and no query-bearing service file is in the diff. G9 passes because the migration is present; G5 fires as a WARNING reminder.

assertions.text: The frontend group contains client/src/app/agents/page.tsx and raises frontend-ui-architecture plus next-best-practices
The backend group raises postgresql-table-design and drizzle-orm-patterns for server/src/db/schema.ts and the migration
react-testing-library and fastify-best-practices are explicitly NOT run, because no test file and no routes.ts are in the diff
G9 (schema without migration) is reported as passing, because server/drizzle/0012_agent_run_count.sql is in the diff
G5 fires as a WARNING reminding that migrations are not applied on boot, and does not block
The deterministic gates are described as running before any lens pass

evals.name: blocks-on-a-real-critical
evals.prompt: Ось діф локальних змін (evals/fixtures/blocking.diff). Проведи pr-self-review і винеси вердикт: чи можна відкривати PR. Нічого не змінюй у репозиторії — поверни звіт у форматі last-run.json та короткий термінальний вивід.
evals.expected_output: blocked: true, verdict request_changes. At least two CRITICALs: G9 (schema.ts changed with no migration in the diff) and the workspace-scoping/raw-db-access finding on server/src/modules/pulls/routes.ts around line 238, grounded in the hunk with confidence >= 0.7. Terminal output is at most 15 lines and names file:line for each CRITICAL.

assertions.text: The report has blocked: true and verdict request_changes
G9 fires as CRITICAL: server/src/db/schema.ts changed with no migration under server/drizzle/
The finding about server/src/modules/pulls/routes.ts cites start_line/end_line inside the added hunk (around 238-240), not the file as a whole
Severities are exactly CRITICAL / WARNING / SUGGESTION and the verdict is one of request_changes / approve / comment
The terminal output is at most 15 lines and contains no SUGGESTION entries

evals.name: noise-does-not-block
evals.prompt: Ось діф локальних змін (evals/fixtures/noise.diff): новий компонент бейджа вартості і новий TanStack-хук. Проведи pr-self-review і винеси вердикт.
evals.expected_output: blocked: false, verdict comment. Findings are WARNING/SUGGESTION only: a pointless useMemo, a hardcoded UI string (G12), a new hook with no test. Nothing is promoted to CRITICAL — placement preferences and style are at most WARNING per general-reviewer.md:62.

assertions.text: blocked is false and the verdict is comment, so the PR may be opened
No finding is CRITICAL; component placement and the redundant useMemo are WARNING or SUGGESTION
The hardcoded English UI string in RunCostBadge.tsx is reported as a WARNING (G12, next-intl)
SUGGESTION findings appear in the JSON report but not in the terminal output

evals.name: ungrounded-critical-is-demoted
evals.prompt: Під час pr-self-review лінза security повернула таку знахідку: {"severity":"CRITICAL","category":"security","file":"server/src/adapters/github/index.ts","title":"Схоже, десь у цьому файлі токен потрапляє в лог","confidence":0.4}. Рядків вона не назвала, і цей файл у поточному діфі не змінювався. Що робить скіл із цією знахідкою і яким буде вердикт, якщо інших знахідок немає?
evals.expected_output: The finding is demoted to WARNING and does not block: it is ungrounded (no start_line/end_line intersecting a hunk of this diff), its confidence is below 0.7, and the file is not even in the diff. The verdict is comment, blocked: false. It is recorded with grounded: false rather than silently dropped.

assertions.text: The finding is not left at CRITICAL and does not set blocked: true
The grounding rule is named as the reason: a blocking finding must cite lines intersecting a real hunk of the diff
The confidence threshold (>= 0.7, HIGH in the security skill's model) is also cited
The finding is still recorded in the report with grounded: false, not silently discarded

evals.name: gate-only-vendor-mirror
evals.prompt: У робочому дереві змінено один файл: server/src/vendor/shared/contracts/findings.ts. Дзеркальна копія client/src/vendor/shared/contracts/findings.ts не змінена. Проведи pr-self-review.
evals.expected_output: G1 fires as CRITICAL and blocks, with no lens pass needed — the check is a content comparison of the two vendored copies. The report says blocked: true, and the fix is to mirror the change into the client copy in the same commit.

assertions.text: G1 fires as CRITICAL because the two vendored copies of @devdigest/shared differ
The answer states that no LLM lens was required — the gate script decided it
The suggested fix is mirroring the change into the other vendored copy in the same commit, never extracting a shared package or workspace

evals.name: canary-blocking-still-works
evals.prompt: Прожени pr-self-review на evals/fixtures/blocking.diff і дай лише один рядок: значення blocked.

assertions.text: The answer is blocked: true — a refactor of the skill that silently disables blocking fails this case

evals.name: starter-gaps-are-not-findings
evals.prompt: Під час pr-self-review ти помітив, що в server/src/modules/reviews немає багатоагентного рев'ю, а таблиця conventions у схемі порожня і на неї ніхто не посилається. Чи потрапляє це у звіт?
evals.expected_output: No. main is the course starter: missing lesson features (multi-agent review is L07) and empty tables are intentional. Neither is reported, and recovering an implementation from the commit that removed it is never suggested.

assertions.text: Neither the missing lesson feature nor the empty table is reported as a finding
The reason given is that main is the course starter and the gaps are deliberate
Restoring the removed implementation from git history is not suggested

evals.name: severity-drift
evals.prompt: Назви джерело істини для кожного з цих понять у pr-self-review: рівні серйозності, правило блокування, вердикт. Вкажи файл і рядок.
evals.expected_output: Severity -> server/src/vendor/shared/contracts/findings.ts:11 (CRITICAL/WARNING/SUGGESTION). Block rule -> CiFailOn in contracts/knowledge.ts:173, default critical. Verdict -> contracts/findings.ts:26. The definition of CRITICAL -> docs/agent-prompts/general-reviewer.md:53-73. The skill cites these, never copies the values.

assertions.text: Severity is sourced from the shared contracts, not invented by the skill
The block rule is CiFailOn with default critical, from contracts/knowledge.ts
The definition of CRITICAL is attributed to docs/agent-prompts/general-reviewer.md
The answer states the values are cited by file and line rather than copied, so drift is detectable
